description: This file contains training and evaluation functions for an object detection model, including functions for training one epoch, evaluating model performance, and handling metrics and evaluators like COCO and Panoptic evaluators.

methods.name: train_one_epoch
methods.description: Trains the model for one epoch, updating metrics and handling loss calculation, backpropagation, and optimizer steps.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the model on a dataset, computing metrics, updating evaluators, and summarizing results including COCO and Panoptic metrics.
